data_contract.actual_compute_split: train only; no dev forward, loss or optimizer
data_contract.teacher_batch: exact 16 rows from frozen teacher one-step engineering schedule; all original source/file/pixel/recipe/crop/row hashes revalidated
data_contract.student_batch: exact 16 rows from separate frozen student one-step engineering schedule; teacher label calls use these identical input/crop/target rows

phases.action: Verify complete real checkpoint SHA/config/58 state entries; copy all old weights bit-exact into mask-aware teacher with 1152 added head weights zero. No inference needed beyond previous frozen inheritance report.

phases.input: teacher batch observed + frozen teacher_weights; no gate

optimizer.schedule: train_rphi.learning_rate(step=1,steps=1000,base_lr=1e-4,warmup=50); exactly one scheduled step, no posthoc lr choice

phases.gradient_gate: All trainable parameter gradients present and finite; aggregate norm nonzero. Clip once. Exactly one counted AdamW step, finite state and actual named-parameter change. Save before/after state tensors and hashes; zero initial mask-channel weights are expected to become trainable, not required individually nonzero.

phases.action: Set updated teacher eval/requires_grad False, clear gradients. Freeze state SHA and config. Deepcopy into generic_gate,utility_gate,shuffled_utility_gate with identical gate seed20261111. All named parameters/shapes/counts and initial bytes match across three students; no shared storage; each has 622900 params (621155 restorer+1745 gate). Only utility_gate is subsequently forwarded/backpropagated; no matched-arm performance claim.

One frozen-teacher baseline with student availability expanded to pixel weights; two whole-slot removal passes, other slot weights unchanged. All three calls no_grad and same student crop/observations/target. Fixed three batch calls even for missing rows, whose labels are excluded by valid mask.
phases.utility: tile_MAE(without,target)-tile_MAE(with_all,target), pool16 -> B2x6x6; normalization .25/255 clipped[-4,4]; unavailable labels zero/invalid; detached.
phases.evidence: Save actual teacher RGB for all three passes, raw/normalized label and valid arrays, teacher state SHA before/after, source/crop/pixel/row identities. Not a persistent research label cache or evidence of useful teacher headroom.

phases.action: Single observed/availability forward, matched_losses(arm=utility_gate) with fixed fidelity plus .01 auxiliary SmoothL1; one unscaled FP32 backward. No optimizer is constructed for any student.
phases.gradient_gate: Every active student trainable gradient present and finite; aggregate gate-final-convolution and RGB output-tail gradient norms nonzero. Gate first convolution may have exactly zero gradient at the zero-initialized final layer and must not be falsely rejected. Inactive generic/shuffled students remain grad=None and bytes unchanged. Save raw gradient arrays/hashes; all three student parameter bytes remain exactly initial.

phases.action: Use detached normal student prediction and exact saved effective gate weights. Remove each history slot in turn without rerunning gate, keep other slot weights exact, no_grad same restorer. Report own raw utility maps/sign support descriptively on this training batch; this is a wiring check, not held-out student utility acceptance.

precision_and_runtime.guard: New owned subprocess group only; hard wall/RSS stop terminates owned descendants then writes failure. Never stop other jobs. No retries or automatic schedule extension.

hard: All pending bindings resolved and root review/admission present before execution
Exact counts and actual pixel/source/role/recipe validation
No GT/labels/metadata arguments in model.forward beyond declared control construction
All saved arrays finite and file/content hashes independently verified

No NPU/Comfy imports, no target fed to ordinary observed path
